summary_for_children: At-Takathur warns that competing for more distracts people until they reach the graves.
environment_concept: Towers of crates, jars and boxes stacked higher and higher beside the path, each trying to outgrow the last (102:1). Further on, a quiet walled graveyard with plain, unmarked stones (102:2). No person is shown. The Day of Judgement and the Fire are not pictured.
architecture_and_scenery: Stacked crate towers, a low graveyard wall with a gate, plain upright stones.

areas.name: Towers of More
areas.description: Towers of crates and jars, each stacked higher than the one before.

areas.name: The Quiet Graveyard
areas.description: A walled graveyard with plain stones. A calm place to remember that this life ends.
